model: RBP v2 (8-component BP, default weights, seed cohort)

previousValidation.note: Computed 2026-11-07 with the identical method (intersection-local ranks) against the pre-update GFP_RANKINGS_2025 array, archived in git history. Caution: the tail of that array (roughly ranks 56-145) was not real GFP data — powerIndex values there were arithmetic filler (e.g. DZA listed #83 vs real GFP #27), which depressed the 2025 correlation and makes the 2025 figure a lower bound, not a clean baseline.

sameCountriesSubset2026.note: GFP 2026 recomputed on the same 112 countries present in both GFP editions and the seed cohort

notes: PHL (Philippines) is in GFP 2026 (#41) but missing from the intersection: the seed cohort keys the Philippines as PHI (alias), not PHL.
All rank statistics use ranks re-based inside the intersection (source lists differ in length: 195 seed vs 145 GFP).
GFP excludes nuclear weapons from its index; the v2 model scores them (weapon component). No nuclear state appears in the top-10 divergences for 2026.
